scenario: Inmate is ordered to submit to hand restraints during a security check and refuses with an exact quote.
notes: Common practice pattern. Good candidate for expanding beyond return-to-cell cases.

scenario: Inmate is instructed to exit confinement/relocate to general population and refuses.
Inmate refuses restraints because of a housing/cellmate issue; quote is approximate rather than exact.
Inmate is ordered to submit to restraints or comply with shower movement and refuses.
notes: Useful because shower-related refusals showed up repeatedly.

scenario: Inmate is instructed by medical/security staff to sign or comply with a medical refusal/documentation directive and refuses.
notes: Needs careful charge-boundary handling so the 6-1 order is clear.

scenario: Inmate says nothing but refuses by action, such as remaining in place or refusing to place hands through flap.
Inmate disobeys a written movement or housing directive.
notes: Current writer supports verbal/written order; should be tested.

scenario: Another staff member is present and observes the refusal.
